brief:
A Palestinian prisoner from Ramallah has been released from Israeli prisons following years of detention, Eye on Palestine reported. The release marked a significant moment for the detainee, who met his daughter Perla for the first time since his imprisonment began.

Details regarding the length of his incarceration and the specific circumstances surrounding his detention remain unclear. The reunion took place immediately following his release from custody.
